title.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]上，科学官[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了一种身体健壮、适应力极强的四足哺乳生物。他们可以徒步涉水，即使是高大的植物也仅仅达到它们的腿部。 这些生物的暗色鳞片非常坚硬，而且在陌生人靠近时极易受惊。

也许可以驯服这些猛兽，让它们协助我们将来的行星殖民活动。但先研究它们也许会有所收获。
texts.en:
On [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered a race of quadruped mammalians who appear very strong and physically resilient. They run across shallow plains of water, with lush plants reaching for their legs. The dark scales of the creatures are rock hard, and they are very skittish when approached.

It might be possible to domesticate the beasts and have them assist in potential future colonization of the planet. However, we might however happen across some interesting revelations by studying them first.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]上，科学官[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了一种身体健壮、适应力极强的四足哺乳生物。他们可以徒步涉水，即使是高大的植物也仅仅达到它们的腿部。

[Root.GetLeaderName]发现这种动物有某种灵能能力，从它们的行为变化上看，它们可以感应到我们的意图。

也许可以驯服这些猛兽，让它们协助我们将来的行星殖民活动。但先研究它们也许会有所收获。

[Root.GetLeaderName]说这些当地生物会“对不怀好意的人反馈负面回应”。
texts.en:
On [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered a race of quadruped mammalians who appear very strong and physically resilient. They run across shallow plains of water, with lush plants reaching for their legs.

[Root.GetLeaderName] have been able to deduce that the animals have some sort of psionic ability, as changes in their demeanor indicates that they are able to intuitively sense our intentions.

It might be possible to domesticate the beasts and have them assist in potential future colonization of the planet. However, we might however happen across some interesting revelations by studying them first.

[Root.GetLeaderName] claims that the indigenous creatures seem to "respond negatively to thoughts that indicate any sort of threat."

label.zh: 研究它们，找出更多信息。
label.en: Study them to find out more.
Try to domesticate them right away.

label.zh: 让它们自由自在地生活。

title.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

texts.zh:
我们试图靠近它们做研究，但进展并不顺利。它们一发现我们靠近，就要么逃走要么战斗，它们好像从大老远就能发现我们。

这些动物明显清楚我们的意图，所以尽量避免跟我们接触。

至少我们可以从远距离研究它们，也许会有所发现。
texts.en:
Our attempts to study the animals up close has yielded few results. They run away or fight back as soon as we approach, as if they knew we are coming way before we have even sighted their herds.

The beasts clearly understand what we are trying to do, somehow, and avoid being in close proximity to us.

At least we can keep studying them from afar and maybe learn something interesting.

label.zh: 这最起码是一种意志坚定的动物。
label.en: A strong-willed animal to say the least.

title.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

texts.zh:
接触这些动物的进展相当顺利！它们似乎拥有一种灵能感应，可以通过精神彼此沟通以及跟我们沟通。

它们想要自由自在地生活在大地上，尽情享受那里的水果。如果我们不打扰它们的生存空间和食物，它们愿意在必要时帮助我们。

这段佳话应当被广泛传播到人们的耳中。
texts.en:
Approaching the animals have yielded results! They appear to have psionic capabilities, able to communicate with each other, and us, via telepathy.

They wish to be free, roam the land and eat of its fruits. We would have their support, as fellow creatures of the cosmos, if we simply allow them their space and leave their food sources untouched.

Positive stories of how this situation was resolved is bound to spread to the general populace.

label.en: We need the food for ourselves.

title.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

texts.zh: 这些动物非常难以驯服。为了靠近它们，我们被迫使用了暴力和麻醉剂。我们要驱使它们的时候，它们总是反抗。我们必须强迫它们完成工作，但效果不太好。
texts.en: The animals are proving difficult to tame. In order to get even close to them we have to use some force and eventually sedate them. They consistently fight back when we try to put them to work. We will have to force them to perform their tasks, which hasn't turned out to be very efficient.

title.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

texts.zh:
这些动物非常难以相处。虽然我们已经尽可能地温柔了，但其中一部分还是逃走和反抗。我们聚集了比较温驯的一批，训练它们工作。但其中一部分还是抗拒了。我们现在有一小群个体愿意帮忙我们，但这相比整支族群明显低效了很多。

我们驯服这些动物的消息一旦传入大众耳中，可能会对我们的声誉造成负面影响。
texts.en:
The animals have been difficult to work with. While we have been as gentle as possible in our advance, some of them still flee and resist. We have gathered the calmer specimens and made them work the earth for tests. Some rejected that too. We now have a small selection of individuals that are willing to help us, but they will not be as effective as the entire herd.

The way we enslaved these animals may paint us in a bad light, once word spreads to the general populace.

texts.zh: 一个宏伟的哺乳动物种群漫步在水草丰茂的旷野。他们似乎对我们的靠近有点不安。近距离的研究能带给我们更多的信息。
texts.en: A majestic race of mammals roam fields of water grass. They seem skittish and have insight into our approaches. Studying them up close could give us more information.
